offence_note: Sexual interference with a four-year-old child
sentence_quote: The judge sentenced Mr. Horswill to 14 months' imprisonment in addition to a term of probation and other ancillary orders.
note: Unspecified ancillary orders; CSO refused; s. 151 mandatory minimum found unconstitutional in companion case.

offence_note: Offences not stated; house search and package, forfeiture order
note: Offences and sentence length not stated; only forfeiture order challenged and upheld.

offence_note: Bank robbery and disguise with intent
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted and the appeal is allowed to the extent that the appellant may serve his sentence conditionally.
note: 15-month jail converted to conditional sentence; about 2.5 months already served in custody.

offence_note: Domestic assault and assaulting a police officer
sentence_quote: At the conclusion of oral argument we granted Mr. Wilson leave to appeal and allowed his appeal, directing that he be credited with 1.5 days for each day spent in pre-sentence custody.
note: Credit raised from 40 days (1:1) to 1.5:1 on 40 days; 60 days computed.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: The trial judge in her careful reasons on sentence considered all the factors and concluded that a proper sentence for this offender was 8 years.
note: Crown appeal allowed only to add DNA order; delayed parole refused; conviction appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Trafficking in cocaine and possession of cocaine
sentence_quote: He received concurrent sentences of 21 months.

offence_note: Two over-80 counts, driving while prohibited and while disqualified
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal is granted. The appeal against the length of the custodial sentence is dismissed. The appeal against the lifetime driving prohibition is allowed to the extent of correcting the order to provide for a lifetime prohibition under s. 259(1)(c).
note: Two consecutive 3-year terms; 7-day MVA jail term and concurrency unclear; prohibition basis corrected only.

offence_note: Impaired driving causing bodily harm and theft of a motor vehicle
sentence_quote: He was sentenced on January 18, 2002 to 12 months imprisonment on the charge of impaired driving causing bodily harm and six months imprisonment on the theft charge, to be served concurrently.
note: Consecutive to existing one-year sentence; member of Anahim Band but no Gladue discussion.

offence_note: Invitation to sexual touching and sexual interference of his daughter
sentence_quote: In these circumstances there is no basis for this court to intervene and the appeal from the nine-month sentence of imprisonment is dismissed.
note: Jail upheld; s. 161 prohibition order narrowed on appeal; deportation concern.
Offences and sentence length not shown; conditional sentence refused given serious record.
